audience: Academic administrators and student affairs officers
purpose: Analyze student drop-out data across two batches to identify trends, common reasons for withdrawal, and academic performance metrics.
questions: What are the most common reasons for student withdrawal in each batch?
How does the average GPA of dropping out students compare across different faculties?
Are there any seasonal trends in student drop-outs?

kpis.name: Total number of students who dropped out
kpis.formula: COUNT(*) WHERE สถานะ = 'ลาออก'
kpis.limitations: Counts only students with status 'ลาออก'.

kpis.name: Average GPA of dropping out students
kpis.formula: AVG(เกรดเฉลี่ย_GPAX) WHERE สถานะ = 'ลาออก'
source_fields: เกรดเฉลี่ย_GPAX
kpis.limitations: Excludes students with missing GPA data.

kpis.name: Most common reasons for withdrawal
kpis.formula: COUNT(สาเหตุการลาออก) WHERE สถานะ = 'ลาออก'
source_fields: สาเหตุการลาออก
kpis.limitations: Counts only students with status 'ลาออก'.
